SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_order WHERE visit_date >= #{startDate} AND visit_date <= #{endDate} AND status IN ('paid', 'used') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(visit_date)
SELECT spot_id AS spotId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM entry_record WHERE DATE(entry_time) = #{date} AND exit_time IS NULL AND spot_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY spot_id
SELECT * FROM ticket_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM ticket_visitor WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT ticket_type as ticketType, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(quantity) as totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) as totalRevenue FROM ticket_order WHERE status IN ('paid', 'used') GROUP BY ticket_type

SELECT CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 17 THEN '0-17岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50岁' ELSE '50岁以上' END as ageGroup, COUNT(*) as value FROM visitor WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ageGroup ORDER BY MIN(age)
SELECT CASE WHEN gender = 1 THEN '男性' WHEN gender = 2 THEN '女性' ELSE '未知' END as genderName, COUNT(*) as value FROM visitor WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY gender
